events.title: Death toll from shipwreck off northern coast of Cyprus up to 14
events.description: A shipwreck near the northern coast of Cyprus resulted in up to 14 deaths among the 267 people on board.

events.title: Iran says plans to announce new ‘exclusion zone’ near Strait of Hormuz
events.description: Iran announced it will create an exclusion zone around the Strait of Hormuz and sanction any ship that enters it.

events.title: Stray US glide bomb likely hit wedding in Iran – WaPo
events.description: U.S. investigators say a stray glide bomb probably caused a deadly blast at a wedding in Iran, resulting in civilian casualties.

events.title: Witkoff And Kushner Arrive In Kyiv After Talks With Putin In Moscow
events.description: U.S. envoys arrived in Kyiv following meetings with Russian officials in Moscow, signalling a renewed diplomatic push for peace in Ukraine.

events.title: EU Commission chief Von der Leyen visits Greenland to sign new partnership deal
events.description: Ursula von der Leyen llegó a Nuuk para firmar un acuerdo de cooperación que profundiza la relación entre la UE y Groenlandia.

events.title: US‑backed effort to disarm Iraq’s Iran‑linked militias hits setback
events.description: Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al‑Zaidi’s plan to bring militia weapons under state control stalls as groups resist disarmament.

events.title: Chile hosts Falklands trade mission despite sovereignty row
events.description: Un grupo de 25 empresarios de las Islas Malvinas viajó a Punta Arenas, Chile, para conversaciones comerciales y la apertura de una nueva ruta marítima, pese a la disputa de soberanía con Argentina.

events.title: Iran claims strike on US ship in Strait of Hormuz as fighting escalates
events.description: Irán afirmó haber atacado un buque estadounidense que transitaba por el estrecho de Hormuz, intensificando la tensión en la zona.

events.title: Lee arrives in France, set for summit with Macron in Paris
events.description: South Korean President Lee Jae‑Myung arrived in Paris for a bilateral summit with French President Emmanuel Macron.

events.title: Ho Chi Minh City delays low-emission zone rollout by 6 months
events.description: Vietnam’s biggest city postponed the implementation of its low‑emission traffic zone, pushing the start date back half a year.

events.title: US Marines are training to jam enemy drones before they can reach US amphibious assault ships
events.description: Marines aboard the USS Makin Island practiced using upgraded counter‑drone systems to detect and jam hostile UAVs.

events.title: Missile Shortage Forces Ukraine To Use 1970s‑Era R‑60 Against Russian Drones
events.description: Facing a lack of modern missiles, Ukrainian MiG‑29 pilots have re‑activated the Soviet‑era R‑60 to engage Russian drone threats.

events.title: Milei quiets ruling‑party rifts, reclaims agenda via Malvinas
events.description: Argentine President Javier Milei’s nationwide broadcast aimed to calm internal party disputes and refocus attention on the Falklands issue.

events.title: U.S. envoys Witkoff and Kushner meet with Zelenskyy in Kyiv after peace talks in Moscow
events.description: Trump‑appointed envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner arrived in Kyiv for talks with President Zelenskyy following meetings with President Putin in Moscow.

events.title: Witkoff and Kushner meet with Putin about ending Ukraine war
events.description: President‑appointed envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner met Russian President Vladimir Putin at the Kremlin to discuss U.S. proposals for ending the conflict in Ukraine.

events.title: Iran war live: IRGC claims new attacks on US warships over naval blockade
events.description: IRGC says it fired ballistic missiles at a US aircraft carrier and destroyer in the Strait of Hormuz, escalating the standoff.

events.title: Satellite lofted for first Arab country
events.description: Un satellite di comunicazione cinese è stato lanciato per l'Algeria, segnando la prima esportazione di questo tipo di veicolo spaziale verso un Paese arabo.

events.title: US strikes three Iranian crude oil tankers (VIDEO)
events.description: Il comando centrale degli Stati Uniti ha confermato l’attacco a tre petroliere iraniane nel Golfo Persico, segnando un’escalation militare nella regione.

events.title: Putin Meets Witkoff and Kushner in Moscow to Discuss Ukraine War
events.description: Il presidente russo Vladimir Putin ha incontrato gli inviati statunitensi Jared Kushner e Steve Witkoff a Mosca, concordando una pausa di tre giorni negli attacchi alle capitali.

events.title: Argentina's government targets 45 entities over Malvinas oil projects
events.description: President Javier Milei's administration opened sanction proceedings against companies involved in hydrocarbon activities around the disputed Falkland Islands.

events.title: Ucraina: gli inviati di Trump al Cremlino. Putin: "Situazione non facile"
events.description: Il presidente russo Vladimir Putin ha avviato negoziati sull'Ucraina con gli inviati della Casa Bianca Steve Witkoff e Jared Kushner a Mosca, cercando di rilanciare il processo di pace.

events.title: Putin Meets US Envoys, Talks To End Ukraine War Begin
events.description: Il presidente Vladimir Putin e gli inviati statunitensi hanno concordato di non colpire le capitali per tre giorni durante i colloqui volti a riavviare i negoziati di pace in Ucraina.

events.title: Greek Premier Unveils €2.2 Billion in Economic Support for 2027
events.description: Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis announced a €2.2 billion package aimed at easing Greece’s cost‑of‑living crisis and boosting the economy.

events.title: U.S. military says it hit 3 Iranian tankers after Navy ships targeted
events.description: U.S. Central Command reported striking three Iranian oil tankers near Kharg Island, Jask and in the Gulf of Oman after Iranian forces targeted U.S. Navy vessels.

events.title: UN approves resolution in support of map that shows Africa's true size
events.description: The United Nations voted to adopt a new world map that more accurately reflects the true size of African countries.

events.title: Trump’s state capitalism comes to the oil industry with his unprecedented Venezuela deal
events.description: Il nuovo accordo tra gli Stati Uniti e il Venezuela, firmato otto mesi dopo l’operazione militare che ha rimosso Nicolás Maduro, introduce un modello di capitalismo di Stato nel settore petrolifero venezuelano.

events.title: Yemen's deadliest fighting in years raises fears of return to all‑out war
events.description: Around 180 fighters were killed in three days of intense fighting near the strategic Bab al‑Mandab Strait in southwest Yemen.

events.title: U.S. attacks 3 Iranian oil tankers in tit‑for‑tat response
events.description: U.S. forces struck three Iranian oil tankers after Iran fired ballistic missiles at two U.S. Navy warships.

events.title: Masked anti-immigration protesters disrupt UK's Dover port
events.description: Protestanti anti-immigrazione mascherati hanno bloccato le strade intorno al porto di Dover, interrompendo il traffico di passeggeri e merci verso la Francia.

events.title: Iran accuses the US of targeting a tanker near Kharg Island
events.description: Irán denunció que Estados Unidos atacó un buque petrolero iraní cerca de la isla de Kharg en el Golfo Pérsico.

events.title: Masked protesters block Dover port roads
events.description: A group of masked demonstrators blocked access roads to the Port of Dover, temporarily disrupting freight traffic.

events.title: Latvia, Lithuania consider ending Russian grain transit through ports — agency
events.description: Latvian officials will meet to discuss a possible full ban on Russian grain exports passing through Baltic ports, tightening pressure on Moscow’s food‑export revenues.

events.title: Bangladesh opposition launches protest march over energy crisis
events.description: Opposition parties organized a large street march in Dhaka demanding government action on the worsening energy shortage.

events.title: US ambassador meets Palestinians in Ramallah amid settler violence
events.description: U.S. Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee visited Ramallah to meet Palestinian families affected by recent settler attacks.

events.title: Satellite lofted for first Arab country
events.description: China launched a communications satellite that became the first such export to an Arab nation, Algeria.

events.title: Attacchi russi durante la notte, colpita Kiev e una fabbrica a Kamianske
events.description: Russian forces bombed Kyiv overnight and hit an industrial plant in Kamianske, causing civilian casualties.

events.title: Lee touts record-high exports after surpassing 2025 annual record
events.description: South Korean President Lee Jae‑Myung announced a new export record, highlighting strong trade performance.

events.title: Women Were Uluating, Then A Bang: Wedding Guest Recounts US Bombing On Iran
events.description: A US strike hit two family homes in Iran’s Hormozgan province, killing at least five people and injuring more than 60.

events.title: US imposes sanctions on Turkish bank, prompting legal threat
events.description: The United States announced sanctions against a Turkish bank, leading Turkey to threaten legal action.

events.title: Our future is for the people who live here to decide, Falklands Assembly tells Milei
events.description: The Falkland Islands Legislative Assembly reaffirmed that the islands' future is decided by its residents, rejecting Argentine President Milei's statements.

events.title: Falklands Assembly tells Milei: “Our future is for the people who live here to decide”
events.description: L'Assemblea Legislativa delle Isole Falkland ha ribadito che il futuro dell'arcipelago spetta ai suoi abitanti, rispondendo al discorso del presidente argentino Javier Milei.

events.title: Faye government faces deeper Moody’s Caa2 downgrade as Senegal economy oil cash meets hidden debt bill
events.description: Senegal’s economy slips to a Moody’s Caa2 rating amid new oil‑gas revenue, hidden‑debt fallout and stalled IMF talks.

events.title: Amid Iran War, US Approves $5 Billion Sale Of Bombs To Saudi
events.description: The United States authorized a $5 billion sale of precision‑guided bombs to Saudi Arabia amid ongoing hostilities involving Iran and its proxies.

events.title: U.S. Embassy in Havana issues health alert as sanctions limit imports to Cuba
events.description: The U.S. embassy warned of rising diarrheal illnesses in Cuba, attributing the surge to shortages caused by American sanctions.

events.title: Industry minister urges U.S. to ease tariffs on hard‑to‑source steel mill equipment
events.description: South Korea's industry minister appealed to Washington to reduce tariffs on specialized steel‑mill machinery essential for the country's manufacturing sector.

events.title: Why the Falklands Is a Pressure Point For the U.K.—and How Milei, Trump Are Stoking Tensions
events.description: Argentina’s President Javier Milei and former U.S. President Donald Trump have intensified diplomatic pressure over the disputed Falkland Islands.

events.title: U.S. approves potential sale of Joint Direct Attack Munitions‑Extend Range to Saudi Arabia for $5 billion
events.description: The State Department cleared a $5 billion sale of advanced JDAM‑ER precision‑guided munitions to Saudi Arabia.

events.title: Russian air defenses down 480 Ukrainian drones since morning
events.description: Russian air‑defence units have shot down hundreds of Ukrainian UAVs over several Russian regions.

events.title: US sanctions Turkish bank, two subsidiaries in latest pressure on Iran
events.description: The United States imposed sanctions on a Turkish bank and two of its subsidiaries to further isolate Iran’s financial network.

events.title: Il quartier generale degli 007 a Kiev è stato colpito da un drone russo
events.description: A Russian drone struck the headquarters of Ukraine’s security services in Kyiv.

events.title: More than 120 killed in Yemen's worst clashes in years
events.description: Heavy fighting by the Houthis at the Red Sea gateway resulted in over 120 deaths, the deadliest clash in Yemen in years.

events.title: 5 EU nations plan to send rejected migrants to non‑EU ‘return hubs’, target 2027
events.description: Denmark and four other EU states agree on a model to transfer rejected migrants to designated hubs outside the EU starting in 2027.

events.title: US sanctions Turkey‑based bank over Iran ties
events.description: The U.S. Treasury imposes sanctions on Golden Global Bank for facilitating transactions for Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps.

events.title: Venezuela’s jumbo oil deal does little to appease its creditors
events.description: Venezuela signs a large oil-backed debt deal, but bondholders remain skeptical about its ability to generate enough dollar‑denominated oil revenue to repay the debt.

events.title: UAE President pardons Abdul Rahman Youssef Al-Qaradawi following cybercrime conviction
events.description: UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan granted a presidential pardon to Abdul Rahman Youssef Al‑Qaradawi after his cyber‑crime conviction.
